value.title: Subdomain Takeover & Dangling DNS Record Verification
value.content: {"id": "recon_meth_010", "item_type": "methodology", "topic": "recon", "name": "Subdomain Takeover & Dangling DNS Record Verification", "prerequisites": ["dns_cname_records", "cloud_hosting_providers"], "signals": ["dangling_cname", "subzy_unclaimed_provider", "404_provider_error_message"], "verification_strategy": "Analyze DNS CNAME chains of all discovered subdomains to identify pointers to third-party cloud services (AWS S3, GitHub Pages, Heroku, Surge, Azure) where the underlying cloud resource has been deleted but the DNS entry remains active.", "evidence_requirements": ["cname_target_resolution", "cloud_provider_unclaimed_signature"], "remediation_pattern": "Audit DNS zones regularly to delete orphaned CNAME records before releasing cloud services, and implement DNS verification guards provided by SaaS platforms.", "description": "Verification of dangling DNS pointers enabling attackers to claim abandoned cloud resources and gain unauthorized control of corporate subdomains."}
